description:
Use this when the user asks what an Indian company listed on NSE or BSE is: its sector, industry, market cap and a headline financial summary.

Returns the company's identity and classification, its latest end-of-day market figures (price, market cap, P/E, P/B, 52-week range), a summary of the latest quarter and the trailing twelve months, and, where its annual report has been read, a description of the business and its management. For full statements use get_financials; for a sourced report across topics, get_company_report.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
